def handle_exrights(symbol, fields, fq, real_data, tmp_dividends):
    if tmp_dividends and symbol not in tmp_dividends:
        dividends = tmp_dividends[symbol]
        dividend_dict = {key: [item[c] for c in DIVIDEND_COLUMNS] for key, item in dividends.items()}
        new_exrights_fields = list(real_data.dtype.names[8:11])
